tool_schemas.name: slack_list_channels
tool_schemas.description: Lists channels mirrored for a workspace and returns a paged result set filtered by type/status/membership/archival flags and optional case-insensitive name search, sorted by the requested field and order. Results are paginated with `limit` and a continuation `cursor` that you pass back to retrieve the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, enums, or out-of-range `limit`; UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access the workspace; NOT_FOUND if `workspace_id` does not exist.

workspace_id.description: Internal workspace id (slk_wsp_...) to list channels for.

types.description: Optional filter for channel types to include.

status.description: Optional filter for channel status values to include.

is_archived.description: If provided, filter channels by archived flag.

is_member.description: If provided, filter channels by whether the bot/user is a member.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on channel name.

limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

tool_schemas.name: slack_post_message
tool_schemas.description: Posts a new message to the specified channel in the mirrored Slack workspace, either as a top-level message or as a reply when `thread_root_slack_ts` or `thread_root_message_id` is provided, and returns the created message record including its delivery/status fields. If `client_msg_id` is supplied, it is used for de-duplication so repeated submissions can return the existing message instead of creating another. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/empty text, invalid ids, or providing an invalid thread reference; UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot post in the workspace/channel; NOT_FOUND if the workspace/channel (or specified thread root message) is not known; CONFLICT if both thread root identifiers are provided but refer to different roots or the root is not in the given channel.

workspace_id.description: Internal workspace id (slk_wsp_...) used to authorize and record the message.

channel_id.description: Internal channel id (slk_chn_...) to post into.

thread_root_slack_ts.description: Slack timestamp (ts) of the thread root message to reply in a thread.

thread_root_message_id.description: Internal message id (slk_msg_...) of the thread root to reply in a thread.

client_msg_id.description: Client-generated id for de-duplication (mirrors Slack client_msg_id).

tool_schemas.name: slack_add_reaction
tool_schemas.description: Adds an emoji reaction to a mirrored Slack message in a channel and returns the updated reaction state/record for that message. The reaction is attributed to `reacting_user_id` when provided; otherwise it is recorded as the authenticated actor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids or an invalid/empty `emoji`; UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot react in the workspace/channel; NOT_FOUND if the workspace, channel, message, or reacting user does not exist (or the message is not in the specified channel); CONFLICT if the same user already has the same reaction on that message or the message status does not allow reactions (e.g., deleted).

workspace_id.description: Internal workspace id (slk_wsp_...) used to authorize and record the reaction.

channel_id.description: Internal channel id (slk_chn_...) where the message exists.

message_id.description: Internal message id (slk_msg_...) to react to.

reacting_user_id.description: Internal user id (slk_usr_...) performing the reaction.

tool_schemas.name: slack_get_channel_history
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of messages mirrored for a channel, filtered to the requested slack timestamp range (`oldest_slack_ts`/`latest_slack_ts`) and optionally including records with status `deleted`, ordered by `slack_ts` in the requested direction. Pagination uses `limit` and a continuation `cursor` from the previous response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, malformed timestamp bounds, or out-of-range `limit`; UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read the workspace/channel; NOT_FOUND if the workspace or channel does not exist.

workspace_id.description: Internal workspace id (slk_wsp_...) to read history from.

channel_id.description: Internal channel id (slk_chn_...) to fetch messages for.

latest_slack_ts.description: Only return messages with slack_ts <= this value.

oldest_slack_ts.description: Only return messages with slack_ts >= this value.

include_deleted.description: If true, include messages whose status is 'deleted'.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

sort_order.description: Order by slack_ts ascending or descending.

tool_schemas.name: slack_get_thread_replies
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of replies for a specific thread in a channel, located by `thread_root_slack_ts` or `thread_root_message_id`, optionally including the root message and optionally including replies with status `deleted`, ordered by `slack_ts` in the requested direction. Pagination uses `limit` and a continuation `cursor` from the previous response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, providing no thread root identifier, or inconsistent thread root identifiers; UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read the workspace/channel; NOT_FOUND if the workspace/channel does not exist or the thread root message cannot be found in that channel.

workspace_id.description: Internal workspace id (slk_wsp_...) to read thread replies from.

channel_id.description: Internal channel id (slk_chn_...) that contains the thread.

thread_root_slack_ts.description: Slack timestamp (ts) of the thread root message.

thread_root_message_id.description: Internal message id (slk_msg_...) of the thread root message.

include_root.description: If true, include the thread root message in the results.

include_deleted.description: If true, include replies whose status is 'deleted'.

limit.description: Maximum number of replies to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

sort_order.description: Order by slack_ts ascending or descending.

tool_schemas.name: slack_get_users
tool_schemas.description: Lists users mirrored for a workspace and returns a paged result set of basic user/profile fields, optionally including deleted/deactivated users, filtered by `is_bot` and optional case-insensitive search across username/display/real name/email, sorted by the requested field and order. Results are paginated with `limit` and a continuation `cursor` that you pass back to retrieve the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid workspace id, enums, or out-of-range `limit`; UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access the workspace; NOT_FOUND if `workspace_id` does not exist.

workspace_id.description: Internal workspace id (slk_wsp_...) to list users for.

include_deleted.description: If true, include users marked as deleted/deactivated.

is_bot.description: If provided, filter users by bot flag.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on username, display_name, real_name, or email.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

tool_schemas.name: slack_get_user_profile
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns the detailed profile for a single user in the workspace, looked up by internal `user_id` or (if provided) by `slack_user_id`. If both identifiers are provided, they must refer to the same user. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids or when neither `user_id` nor `slack_user_id` is provided; UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace; NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or the user cannot be found in that workspace; CONFLICT if `user_id` and `slack_user_id` refer to different users.

workspace_id.description: Internal workspace id (slk_wsp_...) that the user belongs to.

user_id.description: Internal user id (slk_usr_...) to fetch profile for.

slack_user_id.description: Slack user id (e.g. U0123...) to fetch profile for, if internal user_id is not provided.

tool_schemas.name: slack_get_channel
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single mirrored channel by internal id within the given workspace and returns the channel record. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the channel does not exist in the workspace or is status='deleted'; UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace; VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids.

workspace_id.description: Internal workspace id (slk_wsp_...) that owns the channel.

tool_schemas.name: slack_get_auth_context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity as seen by this Slack mirror service, including the resolved workspace, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption for Slack-backed operations. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the presented credentials are missing/invalid.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace id to scope the auth context to when the caller has access to multiple workspaces.

tool_schemas.name: slack_update_workspace_status
tool_schemas.description: Updates a mirrored workspace lifecycle status (active/suspended/revoked) and returns the updated workspace record. Only declared lifecycle transitions are allowed; moving to 'revoked' indicates the Slack authorization is no longer valid. Refuses VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions; NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist; UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot manage the workspace.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the workspace.

reason.description: Optional audit note describing why the status was changed.
